comment: Arm base offset calibration. v_B is the fixed 3D vector from the cart rigid-body centroid to the Franka arm base origin, expressed in the base body's yaw-projected frame (Z-up). R_B_A is the constant rotation from the base body's yaw frame to the arm base frame A (= Rz(yaw_offset)). Re-calibrate only when the arm is physically re-mounted on the cart.
